records.literal_gloss: And the he-goat, the hairy [one], [is the] king of Greece; and the horn the great which [is] between its eyes, it [is] the king the first.

en.L: And the shaggy goat [is] the king of Greece; and the great horn between its eyes, that [is] the first king.
en.B: The shaggy goat is the king of Greece, and the large horn between its eyes is its first king.
en.R: The male goat stands for the king of Greece. The large horn between its eyes is the first king.

fr.L: Et le bouc velu, [c’est] le roi de Grèce ; et la grande corne qui [est] entre ses yeux, c’[est] le premier roi.
fr.B: Le bouc velu, c’est le roi de Grèce, et la grande corne entre ses yeux, c’est son premier roi.
fr.R: Le bouc représente le roi de Grèce. La grande corne entre ses yeux, c’est le premier roi.

es.L: Y el macho cabrío velludo [es] el rey de Grecia; y el gran cuerno que [está] entre sus ojos, ese [es] el primer rey.
es.B: El macho cabrío velludo es el rey de Grecia, y el gran cuerno que tiene entre los ojos es su primer rey.
es.R: El macho cabrío representa al rey de Grecia. El cuerno grande que tenía entre los ojos es el primer rey.

sw.L: Na yule beberu mwenye manyoya mengi [ni] mfalme wa Ugiriki; na ile pembe kubwa iliyo kati ya macho yake, hiyo [ni] mfalme wa kwanza.
sw.B: Beberu mwenye manyoya mengi ni mfalme wa Ugiriki, na pembe kubwa iliyo kati ya macho yake ni mfalme wake wa kwanza.
sw.R: Beberu anawakilisha mfalme wa Ugiriki. Pembe kubwa iliyo kati ya macho yake ni mfalme wa kwanza.

decisions.choice: Greece: the Hebrew name is Javan
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name for Greece is Javan, from the Ionian Greeks of the coast of Asia Minor. It is a son of Japheth in Genesis 10:2. Here it means the Greek, or Macedonian, kingdom.

decisions.choice: the first king: usually identified as Alexander the Great
decisions.reason: The great horn is the first king of the Greek kingdom that overthrew Persia. Since Alexander of Macedon conquered the Persian empire, he is usually seen here, though Philip his father was king before him; the text calls him "the first" of the kings of this kingdom that matter to the vision. The text does not give his name.

decisions.choice: Greece at every level
decisions.reason: Every level uses the familiar name "Greece" for Javan (m1).

decisions.choice: "Grecia" at every level
decisions.reason: As the English: the Hebrew name Javan is given in the meaning decision, and the reader is helped by the familiar name

decisions.choice: "Ugiriki" at every level
decisions.reason: The English says Greece at every level, so the Swahili uses the published "Ugiriki" (Acts 20:2); "Yavani" is kept for places where the English keeps Javan.

source.text: וְהַ֨נִּשְׁבֶּ֔רֶת וַתַּֽעֲמֹ֥דְנָה אַרְבַּ֖ע תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ אַרְבַּ֧ע מַלְכֻי֛וֹת מִגּ֥וֹי יַעֲמֹ֖דְנָה וְלֹ֥א בְכֹחֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the broken [one], and four arose in its place: four kingdoms from a nation will arise, but not with its power.

en.L: As for the broken horn, in whose place four arose, four kingdoms will arise from [his] nation, but not with his power.
en.B: The four horns that came up in place of the one that was broken are four kingdoms that will arise from his nation, but not with his power.
en.R: Four horns came up in place of the horn that was broken off. They stand for four kingdoms that will come from his nation. But they will not be as powerful as the first king.

fr.L: Et [la corne] brisée, et quatre se levèrent à sa place : quatre royaumes s’élèveront de [sa] nation, mais pas avec sa force.
fr.B: Les quatre cornes qui ont poussé à la place de celle qui s’est brisée, ce sont quatre royaumes qui sortiront de sa nation, mais sans avoir sa force.
fr.R: Quatre cornes ont poussé à la place de la corne qui s’est cassée. Elles représentent quatre royaumes qui sortiront de sa nation. Mais ils ne seront pas aussi puissants que le premier roi.

es.L: Y en cuanto al [cuerno] quebrado, en cuyo lugar se levantaron cuatro: cuatro reinos se levantarán de [su] nación, pero no con su poder.
es.B: Los cuatro cuernos que salieron en lugar del que se rompió son cuatro reinos que surgirán de su nación, pero no tendrán su poder.
es.R: En lugar del cuerno que se rompió salieron cuatro cuernos. Representan cuatro reinos que saldrán de su nación. Pero no serán tan poderosos como el primer rey.

sw.L: Na ile iliyovunjika, na nne zikasimama mahali pake: falme nne zitainuka kutoka katika taifa [lake], lakini si kwa nguvu zake.
sw.B: Pembe nne zilizoota mahali pa ile iliyovunjika ni falme nne zitakazoinuka kutoka katika taifa lake, lakini hazitakuwa na nguvu zake.
sw.R: Pembe nne ziliota mahali pa ile pembe iliyovunjika. Zinawakilisha falme nne zitakazotokea katika taifa lake. Lakini hazitakuwa na nguvu kama za mfalme wa kwanza.

decisions.choice: four kingdoms from his nation: the kingdoms of Alexander's successors
decisions.reason: In the usual identification these are the kingdoms into which Alexander's empire was divided after his death: those of Cassander (Macedonia and Greece), Lysimachus (Thrace and Asia Minor), Seleucus (Syria and the east) and Ptolemy (Egypt). Chapter 11 follows two of them, the kings of the north and of the south.

decisions.choice: not with his power: they will not have the first king's strength
decisions.reason: "His" most naturally refers to the first king (verse 21). The kingdoms that follow are lesser.

decisions.choice: from [his] nation (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "from a nation"; Literal brackets "his".

source.text: וּֽבְאַחֲרִית֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ם כְּהָתֵ֖ם הַפֹּשְׁעִ֑ים יַעֲמֹ֛ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עַז־פָּנִ֖ים וּמֵבִ֥ין חִידֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And at [the] end of their kingdom, as are completed the transgressors, will arise a king strong of face and understanding riddles.

en.L: And at the latter end of their rule, when the transgressors have reached their full measure, a king will arise, fierce of face and understanding riddles.
en.B: In the last part of their rule, when the rebels have run their full course, a king will arise who is fierce-looking and skilled in intrigue.
en.R: Near the end of their rule, when the wicked have become as wicked as they can be, a king will come to power. He will be cruel and clever at deceiving people.

fr.L: Et à la fin de leur règne, quand les transgresseurs auront atteint leur comble, s’élèvera un roi au visage dur, et qui comprend les énigmes.
fr.B: À la fin de leur règne, quand les rebelles auront comblé la mesure, s’élèvera un roi au visage dur, habile en intrigues.
fr.R: Vers la fin de leur règne, quand les méchants seront devenus aussi méchants que possible, un roi prendra le pouvoir. Il sera cruel et habile pour tromper les gens.

es.L: Y al final de su reinado, cuando los transgresores hayan llegado a su colmo, se levantará un rey de rostro feroz y entendido en enigmas.
es.B: En la última etapa de su dominio, cuando los rebeldes hayan llegado al colmo, surgirá un rey de aspecto feroz y experto en intrigas.
es.R: Cerca del final de su dominio, cuando los malvados hayan llegado al colmo de su maldad, subirá al poder un rey. Será cruel y hábil para engañar a la gente.

sw.L: Na katika mwisho wa ufalme wao, waasi watakapotimia, atainuka mfalme mwenye uso mkali, anayefahamu mafumbo.
sw.B: Katika sehemu ya mwisho ya utawala wao, waasi watakapofikia kipimo chao kamili, atainuka mfalme mwenye sura ya ukali, stadi wa hila.
sw.R: Karibu na mwisho wa utawala wao, waovu watakapokuwa waovu kupita kiasi, mfalme atainuka na kutawala. Atakuwa mkatili, na mjanja wa kuwadanganya watu.

decisions.choice: when the transgressors have reached their full measure: when the sins of the wicked are complete
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "the transgressors", meaning those who rebel against God, perhaps including those in Israel who abandoned the covenant (11:30, 32). Some ancient translations read "their sins" in place of "the transgressors", a difference of vowels only. The thought is the same: when wrongdoing has reached its limit, judgment comes (Genesis 15:16).

decisions.choice: fierce of face: harsh, shameless
decisions.reason: "Strong of face" is used of a harsh foreign nation that has no pity (Deuteronomy 28:50) and of a bold, shameless person (Proverbs 7:13).

decisions.choice: understanding riddles: skilled in double-dealing
decisions.reason: The word for riddles is used of hard sayings and puzzles (Judges 14:12). Here it suggests cunning and deceit, as verse 25 explains. In the usual reading this is Antiochus IV (see verse 9).

decisions.choice: skilled in intrigue (B); clever at deceiving people (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "understanding riddles"; Balanced and Readable say what it means here (m3).

source.text: וְעָצַ֤ם כֹּחוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א בְכֹח֔וֹ וְנִפְלָא֥וֹת יַשְׁחִ֖ית וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְהִשְׁחִ֥ית עֲצוּמִ֖ים וְעַם־קְדֹשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be mighty his power, but not by his own power; and extraordinarily he will destroy, and he will succeed and act; and he will destroy mighty [ones] and a people of holy [ones].

en.L: And his power will be mighty, but not by his own power; and he will destroy astonishingly, and he will prosper and act; and he will destroy mighty ones and the people of the holy ones.
en.B: He will become very strong, but not by his own power. He will cause terrible destruction, and he will succeed in all he does. He will destroy powerful people and the people of the holy ones.
en.R: He will become very powerful, but not by his own strength. He will cause terrible destruction, and he will succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy powerful leaders and God's holy people.

fr.L: Et sa puissance sera grande, mais non par sa propre puissance ; et il détruira de manière extraordinaire, et il réussira et agira ; et il détruira des puissants et le peuple des saints.
fr.B: Il deviendra très fort, mais non par sa propre puissance. Il causera des destructions effroyables et réussira dans tout ce qu’il fera. Il détruira des hommes puissants et le peuple des saints.
fr.R: Il deviendra très puissant, mais pas par sa propre force. Il causera des destructions terribles et réussira dans tout ce qu’il fera. Il détruira des chefs puissants et le peuple saint de Dieu.

es.L: Y su poder será grande, pero no por su propio poder; y destruirá de manera asombrosa, y prosperará y actuará; y destruirá a los poderosos y al pueblo de los santos.
es.B: Llegará a ser muy fuerte, pero no por su propio poder. Causará una destrucción terrible y tendrá éxito en todo lo que haga. Destruirá a gente poderosa y al pueblo de los santos.
es.R: Se hará muy poderoso, pero no por su propia fuerza. Causará una destrucción terrible y tendrá éxito en todo lo que haga. Destruirá a líderes poderosos y al pueblo santo de Dios.

sw.L: Na nguvu zake zitakuwa nyingi, lakini si kwa nguvu zake mwenyewe; naye ataharibu kwa namna ya ajabu, naye atafanikiwa na kutenda; naye atawaangamiza wenye nguvu na watu wa watakatifu.
sw.B: Atakuwa na nguvu nyingi sana, lakini si kwa uwezo wake mwenyewe. Atasababisha maangamizi ya kutisha, na atafanikiwa katika kila analofanya. Atawaangamiza watu wenye nguvu na watu wa watakatifu.
sw.R: Atakuwa na nguvu nyingi sana, lakini si kwa nguvu zake mwenyewe. Ataleta maangamizi ya kutisha, na atafanikiwa katika kila jambo analofanya. Atawaangamiza viongozi wenye nguvu na watu watakatifu wa Mungu.

decisions.choice: but not by his own power: his power is given to him
decisions.reason: His strength comes from elsewhere: it is allowed to him by God for a time (compare verse 12 and 7:25), or it comes through others' help. Some think the words were repeated by mistake from verse 22, but they make sense here.

decisions.choice: the people of the holy ones: God's holy people
decisions.reason: As in 7:27, the phrase means God's people. Here the "mighty ones" are either other powerful men or nations, and the holy people are set beside them as his victims.

decisions.choice: terrible destruction (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says he will destroy "wonderfully", that is, in a way that astonishes. Balanced and Readable say "terrible".

decisions.choice: God's holy people (R)
decisions.reason: As for "the holy ones" in chapter 7, Readable says "God's holy people".

decisions.choice: "le peuple des saints" (L, B), "le peuple saint de Dieu" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet's "les saints du Très-Haut" / "le peuple saint de Dieu" for chapter 7: Readable names God's people plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "el pueblo de los santos" (L, B); "el pueblo santo de Dios" (R)
decisions.reason: As the holy ones of chapter 7: L and B keep the Hebrew phrase, R says who they are, as the English R does

source.text: וְעַל־שִׂכְל֗וֹ וְהִצְלִ֤יחַ מִרְמָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וּבִלְבָב֣וֹ יַגְדִּ֔יל וּבְשַׁלְוָ֖ה יַשְׁחִ֣ית רַבִּ֑ים וְעַ֤ל־שַׂר־שָׂרִים֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וּבְאֶ֥פֶס יָ֖ד יִשָּׁבֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And by his cunning he will make deceit succeed in his hand, and in his heart he will magnify himself, and in security he will destroy many, and against a prince of princes he will stand, and by no hand he will be broken.

en.L: And by his cunning he will make deceit prosper in his hand, and he will magnify himself in his heart, and in [their] security he will destroy many; and he will rise up against the Prince of princes; but without [a human] hand he will be broken.
en.B: By his cunning he will make deceit succeed under his rule. He will make himself great in his own mind, and destroy many who feel secure. He will even rise up against the Prince of princes, but he will be broken, though not by human hands.
en.R: He will be clever and will succeed by lying and cheating. He will think he is very great. He will destroy many people when they think they are safe. He will even fight against God, the Prince of all princes. But he will be destroyed, and it will not be by human power.

fr.L: Et par sa ruse il fera réussir la tromperie dans sa main, et dans son cœur il s’élèvera, et dans [leur] sécurité il détruira beaucoup [de gens] ; et contre le Prince des princes il se dressera ; mais sans [une] main [humaine] il sera brisé.
fr.B: Par sa ruse, il fera prospérer la tromperie sous son autorité. Il se croira grand dans son cœur et détruira beaucoup de gens qui se croyaient en sécurité. Il se dressera même contre le Prince des princes, mais il sera brisé, sans qu’aucune main humaine intervienne.
fr.R: Il sera rusé et réussira par le mensonge et la tricherie. Il se croira très important. Il détruira beaucoup de gens au moment où ils se sentiront en sécurité. Il combattra même contre Dieu, le Prince de tous les princes. Mais il sera détruit, et ce ne sera pas par une force humaine.

es.L: Y por su astucia hará prosperar el engaño en su mano, y en su corazón se engrandecerá, y en [su] seguridad destruirá a muchos; y se levantará contra el Príncipe de los príncipes; pero sin mano [humana] será quebrantado.
es.B: Con su astucia hará prosperar el engaño bajo su dominio. Se engrandecerá en su propia mente y destruirá a muchos que se sienten seguros. Incluso se levantará contra el Príncipe de los príncipes, pero será quebrantado, aunque no por mano humana.
es.R: Será astuto y triunfará con mentiras y trampas. Se creerá muy grande. Destruirá a mucha gente cuando crean estar a salvo. Incluso luchará contra Dios, el Príncipe de todos los príncipes. Pero será destruido, y no por poder humano.

sw.L: Na kwa werevu wake atafanikisha hila mkononi mwake, naye atajikuza moyoni mwake, na katika [wakati wao wa] amani atawaangamiza wengi; naye atasimama dhidi ya Mkuu wa wakuu; lakini atavunjwa bila mkono [wa mwanadamu].
sw.B: Kwa werevu wake atafanikisha udanganyifu chini ya utawala wake. Atajiona kuwa mkuu moyoni mwake, na atawaangamiza wengi wanaojiona kuwa salama. Atainuka hata dhidi ya Mkuu wa wakuu, lakini atavunjwa, ingawa si kwa mkono wa mwanadamu.
sw.R: Atakuwa mjanja, naye atafanikiwa kwa uongo na udanganyifu. Atajiona kuwa mkuu sana. Atawaangamiza watu wengi wakati wanapodhani kwamba wako salama. Atapigana hata na Mungu, Mkuu wa wakuu wote. Lakini ataangamizwa, na haitakuwa kwa nguvu za mwanadamu.

decisions.choice: the Prince of princes: God, the ruler above every ruler
decisions.reason: The phrase means the highest of all princes, as "King of kings" means the highest king. It is the Prince of the host of verse 11, whose sanctuary the king attacked: God himself.

decisions.choice: broken without a hand: destroyed by no human power, but by God
decisions.reason: The words recall the stone cut out "without hands" that strikes the statue in 2:34, 45. The king's end comes from God. In the usual reading this is the death of Antiochus IV from illness in 164 BC, while campaigning in the east (1 Maccabees 6:8-16).

decisions.choice: in security he will destroy many: he will strike when people feel safe
decisions.reason: The word means ease or security. He destroys people who do not expect it. Some take it as his own ease: he destroys many without warning or effort.

decisions.choice: the Prince of princes (L, B); God, the Prince of all princes (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 11, the title is capitalized because it is God's (m1). Readable names him.

decisions.choice: "el Príncipe de los príncipes" (L, B); "Dios, el Príncipe de todos los príncipes" (R)
decisions.reason: A title of God, capitalized as "el Príncipe del ejército" in verse 11; R names God, as the English R does

decisions.choice: "Mkuu wa wakuu", capitalized (L, B); "Mungu, Mkuu wa wakuu wote" (R)
decisions.reason: "Mkuu" is the word for sar throughout these chapters, so God as "Prince of princes" and the angelic princes of chapters 10-12 share it, as in the Hebrew; the capital marks God.

source.text: וּמַרְאֵ֨ה הָעֶ֧רֶב וְהַבֹּ֛קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱמַ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת ה֑וּא וְאַתָּה֙ סְתֹ֣ם הֶֽחָז֔וֹן כִּ֖י לְיָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told, truth it [is]; and you, keep secret the vision, for [it is] for many days.

en.L: And the vision of the evening and the morning that has been told is true; but you, seal up the vision, for it refers to many days from now."
en.B: The vision of the evenings and mornings that has been told to you is true. But keep the vision secret, for it concerns a time far in the future."
en.R: The vision about the evenings and mornings that you have been told about is true. But keep this vision secret. It is about a time far in the future."

fr.L: Et la vision du soir et du matin qui a été dite est vérité ; mais toi, scelle la vision, car [elle concerne] des jours nombreux. »
fr.B: La vision des soirs et des matins qui t’a été annoncée est vraie. Mais toi, garde la vision secrète, car elle concerne un temps lointain. »
fr.R: La vision des soirs et des matins dont on t’a parlé est vraie. Mais garde cette vision secrète. Elle parle d’un temps encore très lointain. »

es.L: Y la visión de la tarde y de la mañana que ha sido dicha es verdad; pero tú, sella la visión, porque [se refiere] a muchos días [a partir de ahora]».
es.B: La visión de las tardes y las mañanas que se te ha contado es verdadera. Pero guarda en secreto la visión, porque se refiere a un tiempo muy lejano».
es.R: La visión de las tardes y las mañanas que se te ha explicado es verdad. Pero guarda en secreto esta visión. Trata de un tiempo muy lejano en el futuro».

sw.L: Na maono ya jioni na asubuhi yaliyosemwa ni kweli; lakini wewe, yatie muhuri maono hayo, kwa maana ni ya siku nyingi."
sw.B: Maono ya jioni na asubuhi uliyoambiwa ni ya kweli. Lakini wewe yaweke maono haya kuwa siri, kwa sababu yanahusu wakati wa mbali ujao."
sw.R: Maono kuhusu jioni na asubuhi uliyoelezwa ni ya kweli. Lakini yaweke maono haya kuwa siri. Yanahusu wakati ulio mbali sana katika siku zijazo."

decisions.choice: the vision of the evening and the morning: the 2,300 evenings and mornings of verse 14
decisions.reason: The angel confirms the number given in verse 14.

decisions.choice: seal up: keep secret, close and preserve
decisions.reason: The verb means to shut up or stop up. The vision is to be kept and preserved until its time comes, as in 12:4, 9.

decisions.choice: the closing quotation mark
decisions.reason: Gabriel's explanation, which began at verse 19, ends here, and the quotation mark closes at every level.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֗אל נִהְיֵ֤יתִי וְנֶֽחֱלֵ֨יתִי֙ יָמִ֔ים וָאָק֕וּם וָאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וָאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם עַל־הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין מֵבִֽין׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I, Daniel, I was exhausted and I was sick days; and I arose and did the work of the king, and I was appalled at the vision, and none understanding.

en.L: And I, Daniel, was exhausted and was sick for days. Then I rose and did the king's business; but I was appalled by the vision, and there was no one who understood it.
en.B: I, Daniel, was worn out and lay ill for several days. Then I got up and went about the king's business. But I was dismayed by the vision; it was beyond understanding.
en.R: I, Daniel, was worn out and sick for several days. Then I got up and went back to work for the king. But the vision upset me. No one could understand it.

fr.L: Et moi, Daniel, je fus épuisé et je fus malade [des] jours ; puis je me levai et je fis les affaires du roi ; et j’étais consterné à cause de la vision, et il n’y avait personne qui comprenne.
fr.B: Moi, Daniel, je fus épuisé et je restai malade plusieurs jours. Puis je me levai et repris le service du roi. Mais la vision me laissa consterné : elle dépassait l’entendement.
fr.R: Moi, Daniel, j’étais épuisé et j’ai été malade pendant plusieurs jours. Ensuite, je me suis levé et je suis retourné travailler pour le roi. Mais la vision m’a bouleversé. Personne ne pouvait la comprendre.

es.L: Y yo, Daniel, quedé agotado y estuve enfermo [algunos] días; luego me levanté e hice los asuntos del rey; pero estaba espantado a causa de la visión, y no había quien la entendiera.
es.B: Yo, Daniel, quedé agotado y estuve enfermo varios días. Después me levanté y me ocupé de los asuntos del rey. Pero la visión me dejó consternado; nadie podía comprenderla.
es.R: Yo, Daniel, quedé agotado y estuve enfermo varios días. Después me levanté y volví a trabajar para el rey. Pero la visión me dejó muy preocupado. Nadie podía entenderla.

sw.L: Nami Danieli nikadhoofika, nikawa mgonjwa siku [kadhaa]; kisha nikainuka, nikafanya kazi ya mfalme; nami nikashangazwa na maono hayo, wala hapakuwa na mtu aliyeyafahamu.
sw.B: Mimi Danieli nilichoka kabisa, nikalala mgonjwa kwa siku kadhaa. Kisha nikaamka, nikaendelea na shughuli za mfalme. Lakini maono hayo yalinifadhaisha; hayakuweza kueleweka.
sw.R: Mimi Danieli nilichoka sana, nikawa mgonjwa kwa siku kadhaa. Kisha niliamka, nikarudi kwenye kazi ya mfalme. Lakini maono hayo yalinisumbua sana. Hakuna aliyeweza kuyaelewa.

decisions.choice: there was no one who understood it: the vision remained unexplained
alternatives: but I did not understand it
decisions.reason: The words may mean that no one understood it, Daniel included, or that Daniel himself did not understand. Either way, the meaning stayed hidden, as the vision was to be kept until its time (verse 26).

decisions.choice: I was appalled: I was dismayed, stunned
decisions.reason: The verb is from the same root as "desolate" in verse 13: the vision of desolation left Daniel desolate in spirit.

decisions.choice: there was no one who understood it (L); it was beyond understanding (B); No one could understand it (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew; Balanced says it without naming who did not understand; Readable says "No one could understand it", which leaves open, as the Hebrew does, whether Daniel is included (m1).
